explanation: Mark reachable prefix lengths, starting with zero. From each reachable position, advance by every dictionary word that matches there. The final position is reachable exactly when segmentation is possible.
timeComplexity: O((n + 1) times (D + 1)) time for string length n and total dictionary characters D, including an empty dictionary.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 C++ algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
